name: Fail-to-Pass Test Generation
description: A generated test that fails against the buggy version of a function and passes against the fixed version — proof the test actually exercises the bug.
executionEnv: polyglot sandbox (python3 / node / java / go / rustc / gcc / g++ / ruby / php / mono)

fields.label: Generated test
fields.help: Must FAIL against the buggy code and PASS against the fixed code.
